article.title: 香港冬日節聯動三區活動與逾百項商戶優惠
article.summary: 旅發局公布冬日節在中環、尖沙咀及銅鑼灣設不同主題，並加入指定電子支付優惠。
highlights: 旅發局計劃於11月18日展開活動，至翌年1月5日。
AlipayHK、Alipay和Alipay+的優惠按指定商戶、支付條件及供應而定。
article.why: 零售及餐飲團隊可按分區活動和兌換條件設計店內導流。
article.next_step: 逐區核對活動時段和商戶名單，再安排店內標示、優惠券和兌換統計。
article.detail: 旅發局公布中環、尖沙咀和銅鑼灣各有冬日節安排，各區按個別日程開始。旅發局亦與AlipayHK、Alipay及Alipay+合作，在參與商戶提供超過100項優惠，受指定二維碼支付條件及供應限制。品牌可按商圈活動和優惠資格規劃宣傳，並用門店專屬代碼量度實際兌換。
article.title_en: Hong Kong WinterFest links three districts with over 100 merchant offers
article.summary_en: The Hong Kong Tourism Board announced distinct programmes in Central, Tsim Sha Tsui and Causeway Bay alongside selected digital payment offers.
highlights_en: The board plans to run the festival from November 18 through January 5.
AlipayHK, Alipay and Alipay+ offers depend on participating merchants, payment terms and supply.
article.why_en: Retail and dining teams can align in-store traffic campaigns with district events and redemption terms.
article.next_step_en: Check event times and merchant lists before scheduling signage, vouchers and redemption reporting.
article.detail_en: The tourism board announced WinterFest programmes in Central, Tsim Sha Tsui and Causeway Bay, with staggered district starts. It also partnered with AlipayHK, Alipay and Alipay+ on over 100 offers at participating merchants, subject to designated QR payments and supply. Brands can plan by district and eligibility and track actual redemptions with store-specific codes.
